falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4200 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as the prior bottom held at 4224; this would confirm continuation lower rather than a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent VIX elevation above 35 would signal systemic stress exceeding the August 2024 regime (VIX peaked at 38.5 intraday, closed below 30 within 2 days), invalidating the controlled-bottom thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further by >25bps from current level (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal accelerating recession pricing inconsistent with a market bottom; August 2024 bottom coincided with spread steepening from -35bps toward zero

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
